about: Items so many quests need that an icon would be everywhere. They stay in the data, but the plugin never marks them (no icon, no tooltip). Every addition removes marks, so add only on purpose and say why. Keys are Wiki page names (all versions are included).

items.Coins: needed or spent by dozens of quests
items.Hammer: tool; most players keep one on the tool belt
items.Tinderbox: tool; most players keep one on the tool belt
items.Air rune: rune; dozens of quests ask for a few elemental runes
items.Vial of water: container of water; filled at any water source (author, 2026-11-16)
